entities.summary: "I Want Love" is a song by British musician Elton John and lyricist Bernie Taupin, released as the first single from John's 2001 album Songs from the West Coast. The song reached the top ten in Canada and the United Kingdom. In the US, "I Want Love" reached No. 10 on the Billboard "Bubbling Under" chart and number six on the Adult Contemporary chart. The song also featured in an advert for Royal Mail, in which John starred. It was nominated for a Grammy award in 2002 for Best Male Pop Vocal Performance.
